custom_ctr_threshold_hu.en: Uses the ROI Otsu threshold, falling back to -150 HU when it is unavailable.
custom_ctr_threshold_hu.zh: ROI Otsu 阈值；无法取得时使用 -150 HU

custom_ctr_percent.en: Computes solid voxel count divided by nodule voxel count, multiplied by 100%.
custom_ctr_percent.zh: 实性体素数 / 结节体素数 × 100%

custom_solid_volume_mm3.en: Computes solid voxel count multiplied by voxel volume.
custom_solid_volume_mm3.zh: 实性体素数 × 体素体积

custom_solid_voxel_count.en: Counts ROI voxels whose intensity is at least the Otsu threshold.
custom_solid_voxel_count.zh: ROI 内强度不小于 Otsu 阈值的体素数

custom_nodule_volume_mm3.en: Computes nodule voxel count multiplied by voxel volume.
custom_nodule_volume_mm3.zh: 结节体素数 × 体素体积

custom_nodule_voxel_count.en: Counts voxels in the nodule ROI.
custom_nodule_voxel_count.zh: 结节 ROI 内体素数

custom_area_2d_mm2.en: Computes ROI pixel count on the largest-area slice multiplied by in-plane pixel area.
custom_area_2d_mm2.zh: 最大面积层 ROI 像素数 × 平面像素面积

custom_perimeter_2d_mm.en: Uses the original boundary-mask transition-counting perimeter.
custom_perimeter_2d_mm.zh: 沿用原边界掩膜转变计数周长

custom_convex_area_2d_mm2.en: Measures the convex-hull area of the largest-slice ROI in physical coordinates.
custom_convex_area_2d_mm2.zh: 最大层 ROI 物理坐标凸包面积

custom_convex_perimeter_2d_mm.en: Measures the convex-hull perimeter of the largest-slice ROI in physical coordinates.
custom_convex_perimeter_2d_mm.zh: 最大层 ROI 物理坐标凸包周长

custom_circularity_2d.en: Computes 4π × largest-slice area / squared convex-hull perimeter.
custom_circularity_2d.zh: 4π × 最大层面积 / 凸包周长²

custom_radial_distance_std_2d_mm.en: Computes the standard deviation of physical distances from the largest-slice boundary to its centroid.
custom_radial_distance_std_2d_mm.zh: 最大层边界到质心物理距离的标准差

custom_margin_mean_boundary_gradient_hu_.en: Averages central differences from three pairs of inner and outer samples along boundary normals across slices.
custom_margin_mean_boundary_gradient_hu_.zh: 各层边界法线方向内外三组采样中心差分的均值

custom_margin_mean_abs_boundary_gradient.en: Computes the mean absolute boundary gradient.
custom_margin_mean_abs_boundary_gradient.zh: 边界梯度绝对值的均值

custom_margin_std_boundary_gradient_hu_p.en: Computes the standard deviation of boundary gradients.

custom_edge_sharpness_acutance_3d.en: Computes boundary-gradient RMS divided by the maximum absolute gradient.
custom_edge_sharpness_acutance_3d.zh: 边界梯度 RMS / 最大绝对梯度

custom_hsag.en: Computes the interquartile range of boundary gradients divided by their range.
custom_hsag.zh: 边界梯度四分位距 / 极差

custom_cdf_slope_mean.en: Averages histogram probability divided by bin width using 128 bins in the largest-slice ROI.
custom_cdf_slope_mean.zh: 最大层 ROI 128 档直方图概率 / 档宽的均值

custom_cdf_slope_std.en: Computes the standard deviation of CDF slope samples.
custom_cdf_slope_std.zh: CDF 斜率样本的标准差

custom_cdf_slope_skewness.en: Computes the third standardised moment of CDF slope samples.
custom_cdf_slope_skewness.zh: CDF 斜率样本的三阶标准化矩

custom_cdf_slope_kurtosis.en: Computes the fourth standardised moment of CDF slope samples, without subtracting 3.
custom_cdf_slope_kurtosis.zh: CDF 斜率样本的四阶标准化矩，不减 3

custom_cdf_hu_min.en: Returns the minimum ROI intensity on the largest slice.
custom_cdf_hu_min.zh: 最大层 ROI 强度最小值

custom_cdf_hu_max.en: Returns the maximum ROI intensity on the largest slice.
custom_cdf_hu_max.zh: 最大层 ROI 强度最大值

custom_boundary_convexity.en: Averages the ratio of ROI area to convex-hull area across slices.
custom_boundary_convexity.zh: 各层 ROI 面积 / 凸包面积的均值

custom_boundary_entropy_ratio.en: Separates core and boundary using two iterations of 2D erosion, then computes the ratio of their mean 32-bin entropies.
custom_boundary_entropy_ratio.zh: 二维腐蚀两次划分核心与边界；32 档熵均值之比

custom_contour_convexity.en: Computes largest-slice convex-hull perimeter divided by ROI perimeter.
custom_contour_convexity.zh: 最大层凸包周长 / ROI 周长

custom_contour_solidity.en: Computes largest-slice ROI area divided by convex-hull area.
custom_contour_solidity.zh: 最大层 ROI 面积 / 凸包面积

custom_contour_circularity.en: Computes the mean pixel distance from the largest-slice boundary to its centroid divided by the distance standard deviation.
custom_contour_circularity.zh: 最大层边界到质心像素距离的均值 / 标准差

custom_contour_compactness.en: Computes 4π × largest-slice area divided by squared ROI perimeter.
custom_contour_compactness.zh: 4π × 最大层面积 / ROI 周长²
